newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lend Lease in US$120 mln centre deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lend Lease in US$120 mln centre deal.

text.p: Financial services and property developer Lend Lease Corporation Ltd said on Wednesday it would have an equity participation in a refurbished U.S. shopping centre of about US$120 million.
Lend Lease said it had entered into a conditional contract to acquire a half share in a partnership owning the King of Prussia shopping centre complex in Pennyslvania.
The contract is expected to be finalised by the end of 1996 once due diligence has been completed.
The remaining 50 percent stake was owned by various parties primarily associated with the mall's developer, Kravco, which retained property management of the centre.
"On completion of the current renovation program, the centre is expected to have an overall value of between $US450 million and $US500 million," Lend Lease said.

The King of Prussia mall was the largest regional mall on the U.S. East Coast, attracting about 10 million visitors a year and with projected sales of more than US$850 million once a detailed renovation was completed in the near future.
Lend Lease said Kravco was among the largest developers of commercial real estate in the Philadelphia area.
